review_text: A few doors near Taste of Home and right beside the stairs going to the second floor on one side. Tiny shop with the usual budget-friendly coffee variants and some pastries. At first I thought cornflakes (cereal) were swimming inside on top of some ice. Turns out they were caramel puffs (not even that sweet). Place opens earlier than most coffee shops so that’s a PLUS for me.

Nice little coffee shop in Matina Town Square on the first floor. It was clean and comfortable and had some cool jazzy R & B music playing. I was greeted by the staff and ordered the Long Black (hot) and a Revel Bar. The coffee was bold and a little bitter, but it did pair well with the Revel Bar and I did enjoy them both. There is seating both inside and outside. I’d go again if in the area.

As you can see, I took a lot of photos in this coffee shop. The cafe can only occupy at least around 10 persons (inside) and few seats outside. We ordered ✅Caramel Puff Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Smores Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Crème Brulee Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ✅Spanish Latte - ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Each sip reveals a symphony of flavors, perfectly harmonized, and just a divine balance of richness and smoothness makes these coffees unforgettable! The ambiance is giving retro but intrend vibe. Opens Mon-Thur 7:30am-9pm Fri-Sat 7:30am-10pm Sun 10am-8pm
